relationships.subject: Graphene-based warm uterus acupoint paste
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of TLR4, MyD88, NF-κB p65 protein and the corresponding mRNA levels in uterine tissue were decreased

relationships.subject: Graphene-based warm uterus acupoint paste
relationships.evidence_quote: The contents of serum IgA, IgG, TNF-α, IL-2 and IFN-γ were significantly decreased

key_findings: In estradiol benzoate-induced dysmenorrhea rats, uterine TLR4, MyD88 and NF-κB p65 and serum TNF-α were elevated and reduced by acupoint paste.
Acupoint paste reduced writhing and restored Th1/Th2 balance.
